requirements.statement: An End User can log in through the platform's single sign-on to reach their personal todo list.

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the todo list
After a successful sign-in, the End User lands on their own todo list

requirements.statement: An End User can add a new todo.

criteria.must: A signed-in End User can submit a new todo with a title
The newly added todo appears in the End User's list

requirements.statement: An End User can see their list of todos.

criteria.must: A signed-in End User sees all of their own todos listed
An End User never sees another End User's todos

requirements.statement: An End User can update a todo, including marking it done.

criteria.must: A signed-in End User can edit the title of an existing todo
A signed-in End User can mark a todo as done

requirements.statement: An End User can delete a todo.

criteria.must: A signed-in End User can delete one of their todos
A deleted todo no longer appears in the End User's list

requirements.statement: A signed-in End User's todos persist across a page reload and later visits.

criteria.must: After adding a todo and reloading the page, the todo is still present
Todos remain present when the End User returns in a later session
